notes:
**Canvas comments — thread open** (CHR-1248 / CHR-1258). Comments live on the canvas, not in the Context panel.

- Pins (`comment-pin`) sit with their centre on the anchored element's top-right corner (left = right − 12, top = top − 12; pin 24px). Human = blue, agent = violet, active = ring.
- Clicking pin 2 opens `comment-popover` to the right of the anchored element (14px gap, top = anchor top − 8). Placement order: right → left → below → above (see `comments-flip-resolved`).
- Popover header: anchor node id, Resolve, More, Close. Thread of `comment-message`s (You / agent with badge), then the reply composer ("@ to mention an agent", Enter to send, Shift+Enter new line).
- The anchored element gets the target outline.
- Context panel keeps only the count row (`comments-count-row`): "N open comments · shown on canvas". The row and the topbar comment mode lead to `comments-mode-new`.
- `comment-toolbar` floats at the bottom of the stage: Select / Comment (C) · Show resolved · Hide pins.
- Elements panel is hidden in the comment-state screens so the popover has room (mockup composition).
